description: Scaffold a new Django 6.1 project with uv (`uv init --bare` + `uv add`, committed `uv.lock`, `.python-version`) and `django-admin startproject config .`, or bring an existing Django project up to this catalog's toolchain, then post-process it: PEP 621 `pyproject.toml` (`version = "0.1.0.dev0"`, the PEP 440 convention `iru-python-bump-version` maintains, read at run time through `importlib.metadata`), a split settings package `config/settings/{base,local,test,production}.py` driven by fail-fast environment variables (no `SECRET_KEY` default outside local/test), apps under `apps/` with the custom user `apps.accounts.User` created before the first migration, `apps.core` (abstract `TimeStampedModel`, `/healthz` + `/readyz` probes), a sample `catalog` app (model → `@transaction.atomic` service → admin → API) whose API is Django REST Framework 3.18 + drf-spectacular (default), Django Ninja 1.7, or none; pytest-django + factory_boy fast tests on SQLite in memory and, for PostgreSQL, an `integration` tier on a testcontainers PostgreSQL; Ruff (lint + format, `DJ` rules, Google docstrings), mypy strict with django-stubs (+ djangorestframework-stubs), coverage with an 80% floor and Cobertura XML at `build/coverage/coverage.xml`; WhiteNoise, Gunicorn (`gthread` on WSGI, or `uvicorn_worker.UvicornWorker` on ASGI for Ninja), Sphinx API docs under `docs/api/` (autodoc + napoleon, Django set up in `conf.py`), a multi-stage non-root `Dockerfile`, `.dockerignore`, `compose.yaml` (`postgres:18` + one-shot `migrate` + `app`), `.env.example`, `sonar-project.properties` when Sonar is enabled, and — per the catalog's UI contract — a browser UI tier for the server-rendered pages it ships (the Django admin): `.ui-quality.yml`, pytest-playwright + axe-playwright-python, `LocaleMiddleware`, the shared `tests/ui/ui_screenshots.py` helper and an `AdminLoginScreen` test capturing `.ui-screenshots/` across left-to-right/right-to-left × light/dark with an axe check, kept out of the fast tier (`-m ui`). Invoke as `/iru-setup-python-django`. Accepts pre-resolved inputs via `args` (`key: value` lines) — `name`, `package`, `description`, `license`, `developer-name`, `developer-email`, `organization-url`, `python-version`, `database` (`postgresql`/`sqlite`), `api` (`drf`/`ninja`/`none`), `open-source`, `visibility`, `ci`, `distribution`, `sonar` (+ `sonar-organization`/ `sonar-project-key`/`sonar-host-url`), `accessibility` (`enforce`/`report`/`off`/`none`), `mode` (`new`/`existing`), `on-existing` (`ask`/`keep`/`update`/`replace`) — so `iru-setup-python-repository` can drive it without re-prompting; stand-alone it asks whatever `args` didn't resolve. Announces whether it is scaffolding from scratch or updating an existing project and, for every artifact it owns that already exists, warns and asks Update / Keep as is / Replace (or Stop). Ends by running the same commands the CI workflows and the `iru-python-*` gate skills run. Use whenever a repository needs a Django project bootstrapped with its full test/coverage/type-check/lint/container toolchain from this house template, instead of running `startproject` and wiring the rest by hand.
